name: There is Always a Choice
source:
A medium length Visual Novel about the persecution of Falun Gong in China. It was originally created as an entry for the "branching story" contest held by "Citizens for a Global Solution" (a kind of human rights organization). 

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/choice.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一部中等长度的视觉小说，讲述法轮功在中国遭受迫害的故事。本作最初是为“全球解决方案公民组织”这一人权组织举办的“分支故事”比赛制作的参赛作品。

（摘自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/choice.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
